A.notes: Refined editorial portfolio: condensed Instrument Serif with italic accent, mono labels, one rust accent, dark About band. Case rows have a big metric each. Real contact form, clean mobile. Weaker: spot illustrations are generic, only a small 'Redlines' toggle as signature moment, hero has some dead space, 2 touch targets <44px.

B.notes: Much bolder and more distinctive: Fraunces name hero with sun, marquee, four colourful bespoke illustrated case studies with stats, strong dark contact. Failures: G1 (12px orange mono on cream 3.5:1, grey 4.28:1; 11px stat labels also fail min size); 'Yes, that was me' clipped in its button in the Sparkasse illustration; SVG labels tiny on mobile; 13 touch targets <44px; heading skip; no contact form, only an email link; large empty hero gap on mobile.

why: B is the more distinctive and memorable design, but it fails the contrast gate with real small-text failures and has clipped and tiny text, so it caps at 50. A passes every gate with a consistent, polished system and a working contact form, so I would ship A and fix B's contrast and clipping if the bolder direction is wanted.
